verdict.rationale: Kong's first-party materials say it is a reverse-proxy API gateway offering advanced routing, load balancing, and health checking, configurable via the Admin API or declarative config, plus plugins for request/response transformations. A single community issue reports intermittent route-cache 404s on a very old release (0.14.1) that self-correct. That is a version-specific bug, not a contradiction of the capability. missing for 10: in-depth docs on load-balancing algorithms and transformation plugin configuration (evidence is mostly README-level claims), independent hands-on corroboration of routing/transformation working in practice.
